mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, A.* FROM ( SELECT N.NOTICE_NUMBER AS noticeNumber,
N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle,
N.NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent,
N.NOTICE__DATE AS noticeDate,
NVL(N.VIEWS, 0) AS views,
N.NOTICE_CATEGORY AS noticeCategory,
N.NOTICE_AUTHOR AS noticeAuthor
FROM ADMIN_NOTICE N
AND ( N.NOTICE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR( N.NOTICE_CONTENT, #{keyword} ) > 0 )
AND N.NOTICE_CATEGORY = #{category}
ORDER BY N.NOTICE_NUMBER DESC ) A
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} )
WHERE rn >= #{startRow}

SELECT N.NOTICE_NUMBER AS noticeNumber,
N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle,
N.NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent,
N.NOTICE__DATE AS noticeDate,
NVL(N.VIEWS, 0) AS views,
N.NOTICE_CATEGORY AS noticeCategory,
N.NOTICE_AUTHOR AS noticeAuthor
FROM ADMIN_NOTICE N
WHERE N.NOTICE_NUMBER = #{noticeNumber}
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(NOTICE_NUMBER), 0) + 1
FROM ADMIN_NOTICE
INSERT INTO ADMIN_NOTICE ( NOTICE_NUMBER, NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CONTENT, NOTICE__DATE, VIEWS, NOTICE_CATEGORY, NOTICE_AUTHOR ) VALUES ( #{noticeNumber}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeContent}, SYSDATE, 0, #{noticeCategory}, #{noticeAuthor} )
